decision.summary: NO_ACTION: the earlier 77k bearish expression is already spent and there is no clean late-session replacement on the remaining May 22 board.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Reconciliation is clean, daily_success_cooldown is inactive in this context, and there are no live BTC price-hit positions to manage. The May 22 77k DIP trade opened earlier is no longer an active position, so there is no take-profit action left to perform now. Binance still leans bearish, with spot around 76762, bearish_short_term bias, and a strong negative UTC-day move, but the conservative same-day bearish target has already played out: the 77k DIP market is no longer an available active candidate. That leaves 76k DIP Yes around 0.13 as the next downside strike, which is now a classic second-leg chase after much of the move has already happened. With only 6 hours left, it still needs roughly another 1% lower and sits well below the preferred probability band, so expiry validity is weak. The upside side was also evaluated, but 78k REACH Yes around 0.035 is both low-probability and against the live bearish structure. With no live position to manage and no remaining daily market that is both thesis-valid and expiry-valid, the correct decision is to stand aside.
